title: Anth.us opt-in: the public newsroom section at anth.us/newsroom with a nav link, existing pages untouched
description:
Phase 3 of the `homePage` epic: the first visible deployment. A new public section of Anth.us at https://anth.us/newsroom/ ("newsroom" is Anth.us's chosen segment and label, Ryan 2026-10-31; the CMS stays at https://newsroom.anth.us). Existing Anth.us pages do not change.

## Where the work is
Two repositories:
1. Papyrus: a release containing the snapshot and include tasks (feat commits already release; nothing extra).
2. `AnthusAI/Anth.us-web` (site repo; PR to its default branch, merge is deploy): the opt-in below. This ticket tracks both; record the site PR link here.

## Site changes (Anth.us-web, exact)
- `web/projection.json`:
  - add `"homePage": {"references": {"corpus": "knowledge-corpus-anth-us", "fields": "all", "defaultCount": 6}, "threads": {"enabled": false}, "freshness": {"debounceSeconds": 300, "purge": false}}` (Ryan 2026-10-31: all public fields, confidence shown, 6 per grid). Do NOT add `layout`: Anth.us keeps its authored home page.
  - add to `pages[]`: `{"id": "newsroom", "path": "newsroom", "title": "Inside the newsroom", "description": "What the Anthus newsroom is reading and recommending, as it happens: accepted References, what Cyclotron recommends, and the stories that come from them.", "source": "pages/newsroom.md"}`.
  - `papyrus.config.ts`: `backend.plugins` gains `"home-page"` once the freshness task ships; until then the snapshot is run by CLI after each curation session (interim, stated in the PR).
- `web/pages/newsroom.md` (authored Markus; `::raw` only if the existing page style needs it; prefer bands):
```
::band{size="hero" eyebrow="Newsroom"}
# Inside the newsroom
What we are reading, what Cyclotron recommends, and what became a story.
::endband
::band{eyebrow="Latest story"}
::include{kind="listing" sections="articles" count="1" card="text"}
::endband
::band{eyebrow="Recently accepted"}
::include{kind="references" select="recent" count="6" card="tile"}
::endband
::band{eyebrow="More stories"}
::include{kind="listing" sections="articles" skip="1" count="4" card="mini" layout="bare" tag="ul" class="mini-grid"}
::endband
::band{eyebrow="Highest confidence"}
::include{kind="references" select="confident" count="6" card="row"}
::endband
::band{eyebrow="Recommended, not yet accepted"}
::include{kind="references" select="recommended" count="6" card="row" empty="Nothing is waiting for review right now."}
::endband
```
  Counts 6/6/6 and the one lead Story are Ryan's decision (2026-10-31); all three selections are placed at launch; the band directive names and `card` variants must match what `blocks.py` and Anth.us's `card` hook support (check `web/hooks.py` `card()` variants `text`, `mini`, `line`, `chip` first).
- Nav (Ryan 2026-10-31: yes): add `{"label": "Newsroom", "href": "/newsroom/"}` to `anthus_dom.MENU_LINKS`.
- `web/legacy-redirect-rules.json`: confirm no rule claims `/newsroom`.
- Tests in the site repo: extend `tests/` with a projection test that builds the site and asserts `newsroom/index.html` and `newsroom/index.md` exist, the `.md` keeps the three include lines, `llms.txt` lists `/newsroom/`, and every pre-existing page's bytes are unchanged against a build without the opt-in, apart from the nav link. Run the reader-privacy scanner (`procedures/newsroom/tests/reader_privacy.py` from the installed Papyrus) over `newsroom/index.html` and `_data/home-page/references.json`.
- `package.json` / `infra/site.json` / CI pin: bump to the Papyrus release that contains the include task.

## First data
Before the site PR merges, run `AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production papyrus home-page snapshot --site anth-us` once (production write approved by Ryan 2026-10-31), so the page has data on its first render. Afterwards the freshness task keeps it current; until then repeat after curation sessions.

## Gherkin
Site-repo features (Anth.us-web `features/` if present, else pytest): "The newsroom section lists accepted References next to stories without changing any existing page", "The newsroom page has a Markdown twin and an llms.txt entry".

## Acceptance checks
- https://anth.us/newsroom/ renders with References and Stories; https://anth.us/newsroom/index.md keeps the include lines; https://anth.us/llms.txt lists the page; https://anth.us/ and the landing pages unchanged apart from the nav link (diff the S3 objects' etags before and after, or the site test above).
- Shipped-style privacy scan over the live page and data file finds nothing.
- Lucide icons only; no borders; state shown in text + icon.

## Dependencies
Depends on: references include; edge check (confirms no edge change). All decisions taken (Ryan 2026-10-31); production deploy and the first snapshot write are approved.
